title: chant.notify/v1
description: The event a notify webhook receives (#3761): a wave or environment waits for an approval, a run was refused or failed, or drift was found. Sent by chant's Op waves and by products built on chant (terragucci, SQL Yodeler) through @intentius/chant/notify, signed with HMAC-SHA256 over <timestamp>.<body>. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version.

id.description: The same for every send of one event about one digest (else drift fingerprint, else commit), so a receiver can drop a repeat; random when there is none. The delivery header carries it too.

event.description: The ci. events come from chant ci tick (#4645), and ci.quarantine-passed from chant ci quarantine report (#4677), and carry ci.

at.description: When it was sent, ISO 8601 UTC.

source.description: The product that sent it: chant, terragucci, sql-yodeler.

project.description: What the run belongs to: the repository, or a name the product gives.

summary.description: One line a person can read.

gate.description: The gate the wave waits on.

targets.description: What the event concerns: a wave's roots or runs, an environment's pending migrations. For refused and failed, the ones refused or failed when the product knows them.

digest.description: The plan digest an approval binds.

approve.description: On waiting: how a person approves it.

command.description: The command to run, as the product prints it.

chant.description: chant's own command for the same approval, when the product's differs.

review.description: Under pr-review: the pull request whose approving review would approve it.

status.description: The product's own word for the outcome.

fingerprint.description: The same drift has the same fingerprint, run after run.

url.description: The CI run's page (GitHub, Forgejo) or job's page (GitLab).

ci.description: On ci.red, ci.culprit and ci.green (#4645): the branch and commit. ci.red: the newest decided commit, red after its one retry, with phase and failedRun. ci.culprit: culprit, the first red commit a bisect found for the red commit. ci.green: red, the commit whose ci.red this answers.

quarantine.description: On ci.quarantine-passed (#4677): the quarantined test that passed in the scheduled run at commit, as ci.green.quarantine lists it, with phase. Sent by chant 0.124.63 and newer.

detail.description: The product's own record of the outcome, carried whole (terragucci.outcome/v1).
